The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Wall Calendar 2027 GeM Bid No. : ______________________________ These terms form part of the bid, together with the attached “Specification Sheet – Wall Calendar 2027”. T he bidder shall download this ATC, sign and stamp every page, and upload it with the bid as its undertakin g that it accepts all the terms. A. Item, quantity and places of delivery Item: Wall Calendar 2027, printed, with LIC logo, as per the attached specification sheet – total 8,000 Nos. , to be delivered as below. S. N Delivery Quantity ( Consignee and delivery address o. place Nos.) The Manager (Sales), LIC of India, Division Office 1 Ajmer 3,000 Ranade Marg, Alwar Gate, Ajmer, Rajasthan – PIN 305001 The Branch Manager, LIC of India, Jeevan Raksha (Bhilwa ra-1) 2 Bhilwara 2,000 Bhopal Ganj, opp. Jaswant Talkies, Bhilwara, Rajasthan – PIN 311001 The Branch Manager, LIC of India, Jeevan Raksha (Kota-1) 3 Kota 3,000 Chhawani Circle, Kota, Rajasthan – PIN 324007 Total 8,000 Delivery period: 15 days from the date of the GeM contract, for all three consignees (by 23-12-2026). B. Quality, proof and sample 1. Specification: the calendars shall conform to every parameter of the attached specification sheet. N o change in size, paper, GSM, printing, binding or finish is allowed without LIC’s written approval. A cal endar that does not conform will be rejected. 2. Artwork: LIC will give the LIC logo, the 12 photographs of LIC plans and the list of holidays for 2027 as notified for LIC offices in Rajasthan, on the date of the GeM contract. 3. Proof: the successful seller shall submit a proof of all 12 months and of the bottom panel of the back sheet within 2 days of receiving the artwork. LIC will approve it or give its comments within 1 working day. Printing shall start only after LIC’s written approval of the proof. 4. Advance sample: the successful seller shall submit 2 finished calendars as advance samples, free of cost, within 5 days of the contract, made as per the approved proof. The samples are not part of the or dered quantity and will not be paid for. LIC will approve them or give its comments within 2 working d ays. Bulk supply only after LIC’s written approval. One approved sample will be kept by LIC for inspect ion of the supply. 5. LIC logo and artwork: the LIC logo, photographs and artwork shall be used only for this order and s hall not be reproduced, sold or used for anyone else. No extra copies shall be printed. No name, logo or advertisement of the seller or printer shall appear on the calendar. C. Delivery, inspection and payment 6. Delivery: the quantity for each consignee in the table above shall reach it within 15 days of the date of the GeM contract (by 23-12-2026), free of all charges. Loading, transport, unloading and stacking a t each consignee’s premises are the seller’s responsibility. The time for the proof and the advance sa mple is included in the delivery period. 7. Inspection and acceptance: LIC’s officers at each place will check the quantity and quality of the s upply against the specification sheet and the approved sample. Each consignee will issue the receipt and acceptance certificate (CRAC) on GeM only after its supply is found in order. 8. Replacement: any calendar found damaged in transit, defective or not matching the approved sampl e (including a wrong date or holiday, a loose binding, or a fold or bend) shall be replaced by the seller with a new one, within 5 days of being informed, at its own cost, including transport.

9. Delay caused by LIC: if LIC takes longer than the time given above to give the artwork or to approv e the proof or the sample, LIC will extend the delivery period on GeM by the extra days it took. 10. Delay: delay in the delivery, or in submitting the proof or the advance sample within the time given a bove, will be dealt with under the GeM terms and conditions, including liquidated damages. 11. Price: the price quoted shall include GST, printing, packing, transport, delivery to each consignee and all other charges. No extra payment of any kind will be made. 12. Quantity: LIC may increase or decrease the ordered quantity under the option clause of the GeM bid, at the same unit price and terms. The delivery period for any added quantity will be as per the option clause. 13. Payment: payment will be made through GeM after the CRAC is issued and the seller’s invoice is recei ved, as per the GeM terms and conditions. D. Documents to be uploaded with the bid 14. Documents: the bidder shall upload the following. A bid without any of them may be rejected, as per the GeM terms and conditions. (a) a parameter-wise compliance statement against the specification sheet, on the bidder’s letterhea d; (b) copies of work orders, with completion certificates, for supply of printed calendars, diaries or similar printed stationery to Government bodies, PSUs or listed companies, as per the experience and past-performance conditions of the bid document; (c) this ATC, signed and stamped on every page. 15. Final decision: in case of any doubt about the meaning of the specification sheet or this ATC, the dec ision of the Sr. Divisional Manager (In-charge), LIC of India, Division Office, Ajmer, shall be final, subjec t to the GeM terms and conditions.
